name: harvest_loop
summary: Long-running bash daemon that ticks every N seconds (default 60s) and fires harvest activities on EPOCH-modulo cron-style cadences. Orchestrates EXISTING tools only — pinterest connector, noun_project connector, doc_parser, dag_loop, recursive_workflows. Never duplicates their logic, only their cadence. Each completed action writes one ISO-8601-prefixed line to ~/.cc/harvest_loop.log. PID tracked at ~/.cc/harvest_loop.pid for clean start/stop/status.
engine_pattern: while-true sleep-N loop -> tick() -> per-schedule EPOCH%K==0 gate -> timeout-wrapped subprocess to existing tool -> append-only structured log

schedule.name: noun_project_harvest
gates: NOUN_PROJECT_KEY / NOUNPROJECT_API_KEY / NOUN_PROJECT_SECRET / NOUNPROJECT_SECRET_KEY must be set
seed_queries.txt must exist and be non-empty (auto-bootstrapped to 10 defaults on first miss)

schedule.name: pinterest_curated
schedule.action: random pick from CURATED_QUERIES keys (blueprint/furniture/interior/exterior/lighting/kitchen/avatar_ref/style_ref) -> python3 -c snippet calling PinterestConnector.harvest_curated(category, limit_per_query=5)
gates: PINTREST_API or PINTEREST_API must be set
schedule.note: pinterest.py exposes no CLI of its own, so this is the only step that uses an in-line python3 -c snippet.

schedule.name: doc_queue_drain
schedule.action: find oldest studio/assets/_doc_queue/*.url -> rename to .parsing -> python3 doc_parser.py parse-url <adapter> <url> -> rename to .done (success) or .failed (failure)
gates: empty queue logs one line and skips
schedule.job_file_format: first non-comment, non-empty line: '<adapter> <url>' OR a bare URL (defaults adapter=godot)

schedule.name: dag_loop_and_recursion_refresh
schedule.action: cc loop cycle (preferred via core/cc.sh) OR python3 dag_loop.py cycle (fallback), then python3 recursive_workflows.py all to refresh the 5th sub-DAG

env_vars.MYSPACE_ROOT: default /data/Projects/MySpace++ — let the daemon survive cwd changes
env_vars.HARVEST_FORCE_ALL: set to 1 to force every schedule to fire on the current tick (smoke testing)
env_vars.PYTHON_BIN: default python3 — override if a venv-scoped python is needed

inbound_callers: cron */N * * * * bash harvest_loop.sh tick (push cadence externally instead of running the daemon)
outbound_calls: core/cc.sh loop cycle (preferred) | python3 core/lib/dag_loop.py cycle (fallback)

guarantees: set -u (no set -e): a single harvest failure never kills the daemon
Connectivity-gated: missing API key skips silently with one log line, never crashes
Timeout-wrapped: every python subprocess uses `timeout` so a stuck connector can't block the loop
Idempotent tick: running `tick` twice in the same second yields the same EPOCH-modulo decisions
Crystal anchoring delegated to the underlying tools (InferenceLogger / pinterest connector / dag_loop) — daemon never double-anchors
PID hygiene: stop removes the pidfile; stale pidfiles are detected on start and replaced
Append-only log: never rotates or truncates ~/.cc/harvest_loop.log
HARVEST_FORCE_ALL=1: smoke-test escape hatch that bypasses all EPOCH gates for one tick
constraints: Does NOT modify cc.sh, .env, or any connector file
Does NOT install packages — pure bash + python3 (already required by MySpace++)
Does NOT re-anchor crystals — every successful harvest's underlying script already logs to the master chain
Does NOT duplicate connector logic — only orchestrates their CLIs (or, for pinterest, an in-line -c snippet)
Single new bash file at core/scripts/harvest_loop.sh + this agent_def card + seed_queries.txt

smoke_test.start_stop: bash core/scripts/harvest_loop.sh start & sleep 1.5; bash core/scripts/harvest_loop.sh status; bash core/scripts/harvest_loop.sh stop

usage_example:
bash core/scripts/harvest_loop.sh start --interval 60
# tail the log
tail -F ~/.cc/harvest_loop.log
# graceful stop
bash core/scripts/harvest_loop.sh stop
